messages:
Nish Patel: quick thread - after enabling per-project sticky routing in canary we saw quota misattribution for tenant `harbor-tech` at ~08:12. Billing dash shows project="-" for some requests.
Rae Kim: i saw the same. Spike aligns with canary flip at 08:10. suspect proxy is routing before quota lookup and quota service sees the routed pool id.
Leo Ortiz: PR changed proxy to set header `x-routed-pool` early to aid batching. we assumed quota lookup uses claims extracted earlier, apparently not always.
June: mitigation: flipped feature flag routing.sticky.harbor-tech -> OFF for that tenant. deploy-bot accepted the flag.
deploy-bot: feature flag change applied (routing.sticky.harbor-tech=false) run=ff-7721
Nish Patel: short-term runbook item: if project attribution diverges, enable per-tenant fallback via console and notify billing.
Rae Kim: longer-term fix options: (1) re-order so quota lookup occurs before routing, or (2) forward original project claim in `x-original-project` and have quota prefer it. I prefer 2 to keep batching perf.
Leo Ortiz: agree option 2. i'll prototype header passthrough in proxy and add an integration test that quota prefers x-original-project.
Nish Patel: also add telemetry tag `auth.routing.decision` in token logs so we can correlate routing vs quota attribution in dashboards.
June: will add a dashboard card: "routing decision vs quota project" and a simple alert: if any tenant >1% requests with project=unknown for >2m after rollout, page eng-platform.
Rae Kim: owner assignments: Leo -> header + tests, Nish -> telemetry + alert, June -> runbook + dashboards.
Nish Patel: timeline: header + tests in staging today, small canary tomorrow, hold full rollout until we validate. will send a short note to Harbor Tech ops.
deploy-bot: telemetry event emitted: routing.decision.metric updated.
June: thanks all, closing loop once staging canary passes.
